# Test themes

Real themes, used only as test inputs (`../*.test.mjs`). Never bundled or shipped. Downloaded 2026-10-09.

| File | From | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| catppuccin-frappe-mauve.json | catppuccin/vendetta `themes/frappe/mauve.json` | MIT |
| catppuccin-latte-mauve.json | catppuccin/vendetta `themes/latte/mauve.json` | MIT |
| wizzy-onecolor.json | Wizzy-TV/VendettaThemes `OneColor/onecolor.json` | MIT |
| wizzy-pixelcity.json | Wizzy-TV/VendettaThemes `PixelCity/pixelcity.json` | MIT |
| taki-clearvision.json | TakiShiwa/Themes `ClearVision/Vendetta/ClearVision.json` | MIT |
| taki-creamyellow.json | TakiShiwa/Themes `GruvYellow/Vendetta/CreamYellow.json` | MIT |
| taki-ratio.json | TakiShiwa/Themes `Ratio/Vendetta/Ratio.json` | MIT |
| taki-amoled.json | TakiShiwa/Themes `VendettaTeal/Vendetta/AMOLED.json` | MIT |
| luckfire-tachiyomi-lavender.json | LuckFire/vendetta-themes `src/themes/Tachiyomi-Lavender.json` | MIT |
| purple-galaxy-v1..v4.json | ours, `revengeplugin-master/dist/PurpleGalaxy*.json` | ours |

What they cover: spec 2 and spec 3; dark and light values (Latte is a light theme); themes that set
only a few colours (OneColor, PixelCity); old grey ramp `PRIMARY_*` (Catppuccin, Purple Galaxy);
`BRAND_*` only; background images (PixelCity, ClearVision, Purple Galaxy).
